pre: The buyer registration page is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in every field with the test data.
2. Click Register.
data:
First Name: Juan Miguel
Last Name: Dela Cruz
Email: juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com
Mobile Number: 09171234567
Date of Birth: 05/14/1998
Password: Mamimili@2026
Confirm Password: Mamimili@2026
Terms and Privacy Policy: Ticked
expected: The form is accepted with no validation errors. A success message is shown, a 6-digit OTP is sent to the email, and the email verification page opens. The account is saved with status Unverified.

pre: The buyer registration page is open.
steps:
1. Leave every field blank and every dropdown on its default option.
2. Click Register.
expected: Registration is blocked. A required-field message is shown for every mandatory field. No account is created and no OTP is sent.

scenario: Leave one required field blank at a time
pre: The buyer registration page is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all fields with valid data.
2. Clear one required field.
3. Click Register.
4. Repeat for each field in the test data.
data:
Clear in turn:
First Name
Last Name
Email
Mobile Number
Date of Birth
Password
Confirm Password
expected: Each time, registration is blocked and a required-field message is shown on the blank field only. Other entered values (except passwords and uploads) are kept. No account is created.

pre: The buyer registration page is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the test data in the name fields.
3. Click Register.
data:
First Name: Juan Miguel123
Last Name: Dela Cruz@#
expected: Registration is blocked. A message on each name field says only letters are allowed.

scenario: Name with ñ and allowed punctuation
pre: The buyer registration page is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the test data in the name fields.
3. Click Register.
data:
First Name: Niño Angelo
Last Name: Peñaflor-O'Hara
expected: The names are accepted and saved exactly as typed, including ñ.

pre: The buyer registration page is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each first name in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Register.
data:
1 character: J (reject)
2 characters: Jo (accept)
50 characters: Maria Cristina Angelica Bernadette Josefina Leonor (accept)
51 characters: Maria Cristina Angelica Bernadette Josefina Leonora (reject)
expected: 1 and 51 characters are rejected with a length message. 2 and 50 characters are accepted.

pre: The buyer registration page is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each date of birth in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Register.
data:
Born 10/17/2008 (17 years old, reject)
Born 10/16/2008 (turns 18 today, accept)
Born 10/15/2008 (18 years and 1 day, accept)
expected: The 17-year-old date is rejected with a message that the person must be at least 18. The other two dates are accepted.

scenario: Date of birth in the future
pre: The buyer registration page is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the date of birth in the test data.
3. Click Register.
expected: Registration is blocked. A message asks for a valid date of birth. If a date picker is used, future dates cannot be selected.

pre: The buyer registration page is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each email in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Register.
data:
juanmiguel.delacruzexample.com (no @)
juanmiguel.delacruz@ (no domain)
@example.com (no name)
juanmiguel.delacruz@example (no .com)
juanmiguel delacruz@example.com (space)
expected: Each value is rejected with a message asking for a valid email address. No account is created.

pre: The buyer registration page is open. The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com already exists.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the existing email.
3. Click Register.
expected: Registration is blocked. A message says the email is already in use. No account is created.

scenario: Registered email typed in capital letters
pre: The buyer registration page is open. The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com already exists.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the same email in capital letters.
3. Click Register.
expected: The email is treated as a duplicate. Registration is blocked.

scenario: Email with spaces before and after
pre: The buyer registration page is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Type two spaces before and after the email.
3. Click Register.
expected: The spaces are removed and the email is saved as buyer.test01@example.com.

scenario: Mobile number in an invalid format
pre: The buyer registration page is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each mobile number in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Register.
expected: Each value is rejected with a message asking for a valid mobile number.

scenario: Mobile number length at the limits
pre: The buyer registration page is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each mobile number in the test data, one per attempt.
3. Click Register.
expected: 10 and 12 digits are rejected with a length message. 11 digits is accepted.

scenario: Mobile number that is already registered

steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the existing mobile number.
3. Click Register.
expected: Registration is blocked. A message says the mobile number is already in use.

pre: The buyer registration page is open. An account already exists with mobile number 09171234567.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the same number in +63 format.
3. Click Register.
expected: The +63 format is recognised as the same number. Registration is blocked. A message says the mobile number is already in use.

pre: The buyer registration page is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each password in both password fields, one per attempt.
3. Click Register.

scenario: Password missing a required character type
pre: The buyer registration page is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter each password in both password fields, one per attempt.
3. Click Register.
data:
No uppercase: mamimili@2026
No lowercase: MAMIMILI@2026
No number: Mamimili@abcd
No special character: Mamimili2026
expected: Each password is rejected with a message stating the password rule. No account is created.

pre: The buyer registration page is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all other fields with valid data.
2. Enter the test data in Password and Confirm Password.
3. Click Register.
expected: Registration is blocked. A message says the passwords do not match.

pre: The buyer registration page is open.
steps:
1. Type the password.
2. If a show/hide icon is provided, click it twice.
expected: Characters are hidden as dots by default. The icon reveals the password, then hides it again.

pre: The buyer registration page is open.
steps:
1. Fill in all fields with valid data.
2. Leave the Terms and Privacy Policy checkbox unticked.
3. Click Register.
expected: Registration is blocked. A message says the Terms and Privacy Policy must be accepted.

pre: The buyer registration page is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
steps:
1. Fill in all fields with the Account 2 data from the Test Data sheet.
2. Click Register three times in quick succession.
data: Account 2 data (Test Data sheet, column G)
expected: Only one account is created and only one OTP email is sent. No duplicate-email error page appears.

pre: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification page is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.
steps:
1. Enter the OTP from the email within 5 minutes.
2. Click Verify.
data: OTP: the code in the email (for example 482913)
expected: Verification succeeds. The account status changes from Unverified to Active. A success message is shown and the login page (or home page) opens.

pre: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification page is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.
steps:
1. Enter a code different from the one in the email.
2. Click Verify.
data: OTP: 000000 (use 111111 if the real code is 000000)
expected: Verification fails with an invalid-code message. The account stays Unverified.

pre: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification page is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.
steps:
1. Enter each value in the test data, one per attempt.
2. Click Verify.
expected: Each value is rejected. The account stays Unverified.

pre: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification page is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.
steps:
1. Wait until 5 minutes and 1 second have passed since the OTP was sent.
2. Enter the OTP from the email.
3. Click Verify.
data: OTP: the correct code, entered at 5:01 or later
expected: Verification fails with a message that the code has expired, and a Resend option is offered. The account stays Unverified.

pre: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification page is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.
steps:
1. Click Resend OTP.
2. Enter the first code and click Verify.
3. Enter the second code and click Verify.
data: First code (for example 482913), then the second code (for example 907356)
expected: A new OTP email arrives. The first code is rejected. The second code is accepted and the account is verified.

scenario: Log in before verifying the email
pre: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com exists with status Unverified.
steps:
1. Open the login page.
2. Log in with the unverified account.
expected: The user is not given access. The verification page or a message asking to verify the email is shown.

scenario: Log in with the new verified account
pre: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com is verified and Active.
steps:
1. Open the login page.
2. Enter the email and password.
3. Click Log In.
expected: Login succeeds. The buyer home page opens and the name Juan Miguel is shown.
